map.加权评分 = Σ(提及次数 × 评分) ÷ Σ提及次数: Weighted score = Σ(mention count × rating) ÷ Σ mention count

map.📚 深度解析：焦点小组编码频次与评分统计: 📚 Deep Dive: Focus Group Code Frequency and Rating Statistics
map.座谈结束后把整理好的编码表逐行录入，「编码名,提及次数,评分」三列一次到位，直接: After the discussion, enter the organized coding sheet row by row; the three columns "code name, mention count, rating" are entered at once, directly yielding each theme mention ratio.
map.用 CR3（前三项提及占比之和）判断观点是否集中：数值高说明座谈中少数几个主导话: Use CR3 (sum of top three mention ratios) to judge whether opinions are concentrated: a high value means a few dominant topics occupied most of the discussion.
map.把评分与提及次数结合看：提及多但评分低的主题往往是普遍痛点且不严重，提及少却评分: Combine rating with mention count: themes mentioned often but rated low are usually common pains that are not severe, while those mentioned little but rated high may be key minorities.
map.录入「价格敏感,12,4」「口感偏好,9,5」「品牌认知,7,3」「购买渠道,5: Enter "Price sensitivity,12,4" "Taste preference,9,5" "Brand awareness,7,3" "Purchase channel,5,2" "After-sales concern,3,4"; total mentions 36. Price sensitivity 33.3%, taste preference 25.0%, brand awareness 19.4%, CR3 = 77.8%, indicating the discussion is highly concentrated on the top three themes, usable as the top-level categories of the codebook.
map.均值与加权均值为什么不同: Why do the mean and weighted mean differ
map.上述五项的评分算术均值为 3.60，而按提及次数加权后为 3.78。差异来自「口: The arithmetic mean of the five ratings is 3.60, while the mention-weighted mean is 3.78. The difference comes from "taste preference" being mentioned 9 times and rated 5: it appeared a lot in discussion and deserves more weight after weighting. If the gap is obvious, use the weighted value as the decision basis and state the standard.
map.只在少数人那里出现的主题: Themes appearing only among a few
map.某主题只被 2 次提及却拿到 5 分，占比仅 5.6%，排序垫底。这类「低频高评: A theme mentioned only 2 times but rated 5, with a mere 5.6% share, ranks last. Such "low-frequency high-rating" cases should not be ignored directly:
map.小的焦点小组里，它可能代表尚未被多数人意识到的潜在需求，值得在后续问卷中单独验证: In a small focus group, it may represent a latent need not yet recognized by most, worth verifying separately in follow-up surveys.
map.工具能帮我做质性编码吗？: Can the tool do qualitative coding for me?
map.不能。它只在你完成开放编码、把主题整理成「编码名 + 提及次数 + 评分」之后做: No. It only does statistics after you finish open coding and organize themes into "code name + mention count + rating". Axial coding, theme distillation and theoretical saturation judgment still require manual work.
map.录入格式有什么要求？: What are the entry format requirements?
map.每行一条，用逗号、顿号、分号或空格分隔均可；至少要有编码名与提及次数两列，第三列: One per row, separated by comma, enumeration comma, semicolon or space; at least the code name and mention count two columns, the third is rating (suggest 1–5). Rows missing mention count are skipped with a note in the result, not counted as 0 to mix into statistics.
map.参会人数少，统计结果有意义吗？: With few participants, are the statistics meaningful?
map.焦点小组通常只有 8~12 人，均值的代表性有限。建议重点看提及次数排序、占比与: Focus groups usually have only 8–12 people, so the mean representativeness is limited. It is suggested to focus on mention-count ranking, ratio and CR3, treating the results as organizing clues and hypothesis sources for follow-up surveys, rather than directly generalizable conclusions.
